title: Cable - Deadpool Protocol
summary: This Pool Cable list mixes X-Force allies with Deadpool Corps chaos for flexible board presence. Thwarting relies on Mind Scan chains plus Emergency, Frenemies, Hit and Run and 'Pool Inspection while Live Dangerously opens lines. Damage comes from Telekinetic Blast, Haymakers, Cutupper, Psimitar and ally attacks, backed by Digging Deep, Helicarrier, Genius and Plot Convenience for steady economy.
